name: Terravia
tagline: Laboratory-grade soil intelligence for the serious grower.
positioning: Terravia turns a single soil sample into a certified nutrient, pH, and microbiome report — with season-over-season tracking any grower can act on.

hero.h1: Know exactly what your soil is telling you.
hero.sub: Mail in a sample, get a laboratory-verified report on nutrients, pH, organic matter, and microbial health — with plain-language recommendations for your next planting.

features.title: Certified lab analysis
features.description: Every sample runs through an accredited spectrometry workflow — nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, micronutrients, and pH measured to research-grade tolerances.

features.title: Microbiome profiling
features.description: DNA sequencing quantifies the fungal and bacterial life in your soil, so you know whether your beds are biologically thriving or depleted.

features.title: Season tracking
features.description: Terravia stores every report against your plot map, charting how amendments and rotations shift your soil over months and years.

features.title: Amendment guidance
features.description: Get precise application rates for lime, compost, and fertilizer — calibrated to your crops, not a generic average.

features.title: Plot mapping
features.description: Pin sample points to a satellite map of your property and compare readings zone by zone across the garden or field.

features.title: Retest reminders
features.description: Automatic notifications tell you when it's time to resample, keeping your amendment schedule on track through the growing season.

testimonials.quote: I stopped guessing at fertilizer. Terravia showed my raised beds were sitting at pH 5.2 — one lime application later, my tomatoes finally set fruit properly.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Deland

testimonials.quote: The microbiome report was the eye-opener. Our orchard soil looked fine on paper but was biologically dead. Terravia's tracking let us prove the recovery over two seasons.
testimonials.name: Owen Castellano

testimonials.quote: As a landscape designer I send Terravia reports to every client before we plant. It's the credibility layer that used to require an outside agronomist.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan

pricing.blurb: One certified report for the grower who wants clear answers.
Track your soil across the full growing calendar.
For large properties and multi-zone growers.

homepage.footerBlurb: Terravia delivers laboratory-grade soil analytics to growers at any scale. Sample, sequence, and cultivate with confidence.
